title: Prove the four-QUERY lower bound across two funded LOCAL calls
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the named standard separated interfaces, the ε-coefficient ranks are 4, 5, and 6 when zero, one, or two funded LOCAL calls are admitted. The exact minors force four QUERY calls even with q-independent mixing between the prescribed ports. This is an interface-scoped rank bound.

## Task and overlap

The calculation follows the P104 caller toolkit in #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212 and the pinned complete P104 supplier in #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. #7865 treats literal intra-block placements, and #7866 treats frozen-stock transport. This packet tests the derivative rank argument in a different relaxation.

## Validation and credit

The companion checkers recompute the polynomial minors, reject each rank-demotion control, and replay the 680-coordinate native operators in forward and adjoint orientations. README records the observed commands and SOURCES.md binds the inputs. The work was AI-assisted with Codex.

## Open next questions

Nonseparated interfaces, q-dependent stock and physical candidate scheduling remain open. No changes to the complete application are asserted.
